purpose: Test whether blocking the action gradient into the heatmap head preserves visual learning while retaining the learned actor connection
targetQuality: heuristic projection, color pixels and detector component, not proven instance segmentation
baseline: matched target-actor-v1 model with a fully differentiable heatmap connection
treatment: same model, initialization, data, shuffle, learning rates and losses, but action gradient is stopped at the heatmap-to-actor edge; label loss still trains the heatmap head and action loss still trains the shared encoder and actor
evaluation: Canonical eight-case screen; paired full32 if either matched checkpoint returns in both room types
